name: 吐纳术
desc: 最基础的吐纳之法，引天地灵气入体，温养经脉。
descEn: The most basic breathing method. Draws ambient qi into the body to nourish meridians.

name: 聚灵诀
desc: 凝聚周身灵气于丹田，修炼速度倍增。
descEn: Concentrates ambient spirit energy into the dantian, doubling cultivation speed.

name: 归元功
desc: 以内视之法归纳元气，生生不息循环往复。
descEn: Uses inner vision to cycle primal energy in an endless regenerative loop.

name: 太虚真经
desc: 传说中的上古功法，沟通虚空之力，日夜不停自行运转。
descEn: A legendary ancient art that channels the void, cultivating ceaselessly day and night.

name: 基础剑诀
desc: 入门剑法，以灵气驭剑，斩妖除魔。
descEn: Introductory swordplay. Wields the blade with qi to vanquish evil.

name: 烈焰掌
desc: 掌中凝聚火属性灵力，一掌击出烈焰焚天。
descEn: Concentrates fire-element qi in the palm. A single strike ignites the heavens.

name: 万剑归宗
desc: 御万剑于虚空，剑意纵横，所向披靡。
descEn: Commands ten thousand swords through the void, unstoppable in all directions.

name: 初级丹诀
desc: 炼丹入门心法，掌控火候，提升丹药成功率。
descEn: Beginner alchemy method. Controls flame intensity to improve pill success rate.

name: 高级丹诀
desc: 以神识操控丹火，凝炼天材地宝，成丹率大幅提升。
descEn: Uses divine sense to control pill fire, greatly boosting success rate.

name: 轻身术
desc: 身轻如燕，闪避敌人攻击的基础身法。
descEn: Light as a swallow. Basic movement art for dodging enemy attacks.

name: 缩地成寸
desc: 一步跨越数丈，缩地成寸，来去如风。
descEn: Covers yards in a single step, shrinking distance to nothing.

name: 瞬移术
desc: 撕裂空间瞬间移动，天地之大尽在咫尺。
descEn: Tears through space for instant movement. The world fits within a step.
